language.script_notes: A Finnic language, closely related to Finnish and Hungarian but not to its Baltic neighbours. The letter Õ is found in no other European Latin spelling and is the surest tell; Ä, Ö and Ü also appear, and doubled vowels (aa, ee, oo, uu) are frequent.

road_furniture.bollard_color: Cylindrical bollards with a rectangular reflector on the front and two circular reflectors on the back.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Warning signs have a thin red border with no extra outline; chevrons are red with white arrows; kilometre markers stand perpendicular to the road, and some sign posts are wrapped at the base in blue-and-white wrappers.

architecture.roof_style: Steeply pitched roofs on wooden farmhouses and villas; flat roofs on Soviet apartment blocks; steep spires in the medieval capital.
architecture.roof_material: Corrugated metal and tile on houses, and flat roofing on blocks.
architecture.wall_construction: Timber houses and villas; white or grey Soviet panel blocks (khrushchyovka) at the centre of many villages, from three to five storeys; Hanseatic medieval stone in Tallinn's old town.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Painted timber in muted red, yellow and green, grey and white block housing.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Timber farmhouses; Soviet blocks and cultural halls in rural centres; Tallinn's walled medieval old town; windmills and stone farm buildings on the islands.

nature.vegetation: Boreal forest of pine, spruce and birch, wet bogs and meadows, and open fields; a good bet when on a dirt road through open European-style fields with no other clue.
nature.terrain: Low-lying, flat to gently rolling land with many lakes, bogs and a long, indented Baltic coast with islands; the highest ground barely exceeds 300m.
nature.climate_signature: Cool, damp, often overcast, with long winters and very long summer evenings.

vehicles.plate_color: White plate with black text and a blue EU strip on the left carrying 'EST'.
vehicles.plate_format: Three digits followed by three letters (e.g. '123 ABC').

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Dense coverage of roads, including many gravel roads.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Neighbouring Baltic landscape, Soviet blocks and timber houses
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Bollards here are cylindrical with round reflectors on the back, and Õ and Ä letters appear in Estonian only; Latvian signs use long-mark vowels and have thicker red borders on warning signs.

confusion_set.shared_traits: A related Finnic language with Ä and Ö, similar forests, lakes and timber houses
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The letter Õ exists only in Estonian; Finnish signs are bilingual with Swedish and Finnish plates differ.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Soviet blocks, birch forest and dirt roads near the eastern border
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Latin script with Õ and EU plates versus Cyrillic and Russian plates.
